subject.title: fix(queue): dedupe unchanged pull request edits

question: Should exact-review ingress coalesce repeated `pull_request.edited` deliveries with the same review-relevant tuple for seven days, rather than create a new review revision for each distinct delivery?
rationale: The patch is technically scoped and has local runtime proof, but it intentionally changes the durable event-admission policy and retention semantics; current-main evidence supplied here does not establish that policy as an already-approved contract.

options.title: Adopt scoped semantic coalescing
options.body: Accept unchanged edited-event suppression at ingress while retaining enqueue behavior for changed or incomplete payloads and leaving cross-route coalescing to the separate draft.

options.title: Keep delivery-per-event semantics
options.body: Decline the new semantic cursor and retain the existing behavior in which distinct edited deliveries may create separate review revisions.

options.title: Sequence with cross-route policy
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader ingress identity and retention decision in https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/706 is resolved.

recommendation.title: Adopt scoped semantic coalescing
recommendation.body: Accept unchanged edited-event suppression at ingress while retaining enqueue behavior for changed or incomplete payloads and leaving cross-route coalescing to the separate draft.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the current exact-review queue and Worker architecture that this proposal extends.
